claim: The median fixture (counter, pedestal, shelf run) in Blood's detail maps carries no sprites, and few carry any goods: 28 of 171 in DWE3M1, 11 of 136 in DWE3M10, 2 of 43 in E6M1, 1 of 62 in E4M9, 42 of 412 in all (one in ten; one in six at most, in one map). Fixtures come in families with rise, tile and depth pinned and width free (DWE3M10's counter: rise 3,072, tile 345, depth 1,024, widths 512 and 1,024).
evidence: knowledge/blood/design/fixtures-v1.json (fixtures per map), quoted in projects/blood-city/level/fixtures.py:146, whose GOODS_SHARE 0.14 ('call it one in seven') is above the pooled rate
use: Build fixtures from a family with one free length, and put goods on about one in ten (no more than one in six).
